name: Arch & Vane Pavement Lace-Up
description: A sturdy lace-up walking shoe with a thick rubber sole and reinforced toe. Sits closer to a casual boot in profile but laces all the way up. Muted colors — brown, charcoal, black. Built for people who walk a lot on hard surfaces and want their knees to survive it.
functionality: Removable insole with pressure-mapping gel pockets that conform to foot shape over the first few wears.
what_it_says: You've had foot problems or you're preventing them. Either way, you're sensible.
worn_by: anyone who's been told by a doctor to invest in their footwear
story_hooks: The insole molds to your foot — a forensics team could theoretically reconstruct a gait profile from a used pair.
An Arch & Vane rep claims they've never had a warranty claim. Someone is testing that.
